remarks: Discover a blend of style and comfort in this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath condo townhouse nestled in the lively downtown Stamford. With fresh paint and new luxury vinyl plank flooring, this spacious second-floor unit is move-in ready. The sun-drenched living and dining area boasts an open-concept design, featuring a cozy fireplace and chic plantation shutters-perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Enjoy your own private balcony, an ideal spot for morning coffee or relaxing evenings with captivating city views. Both bedrooms are generously sized, Primary offers en-suite bathroom and ample closet space, ensuring privacy and convenience. A laundry area is conveniently located on the second floor for added ease. Modern amenities enhance your living experience, including assigned parking in the garage, central air, elevator access, and in unit laundry. The unit is pet-friendly to accommodate your furry companions. Located mere minutes from Stamford's finest dining, shopping, parks, and the Metro-North station, this home combines tranquility with urban living. Seize the chance to own a chic and centrally located home in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods!
